title: 第十七章孤勇破重围寒鞘鸣长空第十八章 恩仇缠旧梦剑问是非功
content_zh:
残阳如血，泼洒在乱山险谷之间，将萧琰的身影拉得颀长而孤绝。他一身玄色劲装早已被尘土与血渍浸透，左肩一道深可见骨的伤口还在汩汩渗血，顺着手臂滑落，滴在脚下的碎石上，晕开点点暗红，转瞬又被呼啸的山风卷去痕迹。背后的寒鞘长剑贴着脊背，剑鞘上的纹路被汗水与血污模糊，却依旧透着一股凛冽的寒意，仿佛沉睡的猛兽，只待一声令下便会冲破桎梏，鸣响长空。
半个时辰前，他还在护送密函前往边境军营，途经这黑风谷时，忽闻四周号角齐鸣，伏兵四起。为首的是北狄铁骑的先锋将领，面色狰狞，眼中满是贪婪与杀意，身后跟着三百余名精锐骑兵，个个弓上弦、刀出鞘，将狭窄的谷口堵得水泄不通，连飞鸟都难以逾越。“萧琰，交出密函，饶你全尸！”北狄将领的吼声震彻山谷，带着不容置喙的狂妄，“你孤军深入，已无退路，何必做无谓的抵抗？”
萧琰抬眸，琥珀色的瞳孔中没有丝毫惧色，唯有一片冷冽如冰的坚定。他缓缓抬手，拭去脸颊上的血污，指腹摩挲过寒鞘的纹路，那是他年少时随师父所铸，剑名“寒锋”，出鞘必见血，饮过无数奸邪之徒的鲜血，更陪着他走过无数绝境。十二年前，他随父征战北疆，曾单骑杀穿敌营，那时的他，意气风发，锋芒毕露；如今，他虽身陷重围，重伤在身，却依旧没有忘记自己的使命——密函关乎边境数十万将士的性命，关乎家国百姓的安宁，纵使粉身碎骨，也绝不能落入敌人手中。
“要密函，先踏过我的尸体。”萧琰的声音不高，却字字铿锵，穿透呼啸的山风，回荡在山谷之中。他的身形微微前倾，右手悄然握住寒锋剑的剑柄，指节因用力而泛白，掌心的厚茧与剑柄的纹路紧紧贴合，那是常年握剑留下的印记，也是他面对绝境时，唯一的底气。左肩的伤口传来阵阵剧痛，每动一下，都像是有无数根钢针在穿刺，冷汗顺着额角滑落，浸湿了额前的碎发，却丝毫没有动摇他的决心。
北狄将领见状，怒极反笑：“敬酒不吃吃罚酒！既然你执意找死，那本将便成全你，让你死无全尸！”说罢，他猛地抬手，挥下马鞭，“杀！取下萧琰的首级，重重有赏！”
随着一声令下，北狄骑兵蜂拥而上，马蹄声震耳欲聋，卷起漫天尘土，将整个谷口笼罩在一片灰雾之中。锋利的马刀在残阳下闪烁着刺眼的寒光，箭矢如雨点般射来，带着呼啸的风声，直逼萧琰周身要害。这般绝境，堪比当年萧炎在亡魂山脉遭遇摘星老鬼围攻，那般实力悬殊，那般孤立无援，可萧琰的眼中，没有丝毫退缩，唯有孤勇在燃烧。
萧琰不退反进，身形猛地一侧，堪堪躲过迎面射来的箭矢，箭矢擦着他的耳畔飞过，射中身后的岩壁，发出“噗嗤”一声闷响。与此同时，他右手腕猛地一翻，寒锋剑应声出鞘，“铮”的一声清鸣，如龙吟般响彻长空，划破漫天尘雾，那凛冽的剑气扑面而来，让冲在最前面的几名北狄骑兵不由得顿住了身形，眼中闪过一丝惧色。
寒鞘空悬，长剑在手，萧琰的周身仿佛笼罩着一层冰冷的气场，他的动作快如闪电，身影在骑兵阵中穿梭，如鬼魅般飘忽不定。左肩的伤口依旧在流血，剧痛不断侵蚀着他的意识，可他丝毫没有理会，所有的注意力都集中在眼前的敌人身上。他深谙战斗之道，知道自己孤军奋战，硬拼绝无胜算，唯有凭借灵活的身法，寻找敌人的破绽，逐个击破，才有一线生机。
一名北狄骑兵挥舞着马刀，猛地向萧琰砍来，刀锋带着凌厉的风声，直逼他的脖颈。萧琰身形微微一矮，避开刀锋的同时，右手手腕一扬，寒锋剑顺势刺出，剑尖如毒蛇出洞，精准地刺穿了那名骑兵的咽喉。鲜血喷涌而出，溅在萧琰的脸上，温热的触感没有让他有丝毫动容，他手腕一拧，抽出长剑，带出一串血珠，另一名骑兵趁机从侧面袭来，他左脚脚尖一点地面，身形凌空跃起，避开攻击的同时，长剑横扫而下，“噗嗤”一声，将那名骑兵的手臂斩断，惨叫声响彻山谷。
战斗一触即发，愈演愈烈。萧琰凭借着精湛的剑术和灵活的身法，在北狄骑兵阵中奋勇拼杀，寒锋剑每一次出鞘，都伴随着一声清鸣，每一次挥舞，都能带走一条生命。他的动作干脆利落，没有丝毫拖泥带水，剑剑直取要害，仿佛一尊来自地狱的修罗，令人望而生畏。可北狄骑兵人数众多，源源不断地涌上来，杀了一批，又来一批，萧琰的体力在快速消耗，左肩的伤口失血越来越多，身形也渐渐有些不稳，脚步开始虚浮，额头上的冷汗顺着脸颊不断滑落，滴在长剑上，溅起细小的水花。
北狄将领站在远处，看着阵中奋勇拼杀的萧琰，眼中闪过一丝诧异，随即又被贪婪取代。他没想到，萧琰重伤在身，竟然还能有如此强悍的战斗力，这般孤勇，这般坚韧，若是能将其收服，必是一大助力。可转念一想，萧琰忠心耿耿，绝不会归顺北狄，与其留下后患，不如趁早将其斩杀，取下密函。
“废物！一群废物！连一个重伤的人都杀不了！”北狄将领怒吼一声，再次挥下马鞭，“都给我上！不惜一切代价，杀了萧琰！”
随着将领的怒吼，北狄骑兵攻势更猛，他们改变战术，不再盲目冲锋，而是形成合围之势，将萧琰紧紧围在中间，试图耗尽他的体力，再将其斩杀。箭矢依旧如雨点般射来，马刀挥舞的风声不绝于耳，萧琰的周身，到处都是敌人的身影，到处都是致命的危机，就像萧炎当年被费天的本体与分身形成天罗地网围困，那般绝望，那般窒息。
萧琰喘着粗气，胸口剧烈起伏，身上又添了几道伤口，鲜血浸透了劲装，整个人看起来狼狈不堪，可他的眼神，依旧坚定如初，没有丝毫动摇。他知道，自己不能倒下，一旦倒下，密函就会落入敌人手中，边境数十万将士的性命就会陷入危机，家国百姓就会遭受战乱之苦。他咬紧牙关，强撑着身体，握紧寒锋剑，再次发起攻击。
他猛地身形一旋，长剑横扫而出，凌厉的剑气瞬间逼退周围的几名骑兵，随即，他脚尖一点一名骑兵的马头，身形凌空跃起，居高临下，长剑直刺而下，精准地刺中了一名骑兵的头盔缝隙，刺穿了他的头颅。就在他抽出长剑的瞬间，身后传来一阵凌厉的风声，一名北狄骑兵趁机挥刀砍来，萧琰来不及躲闪，后背被马刀划开一道长长的伤口，鲜血瞬间涌了出来，剧痛让他忍不住闷哼一声，身形踉跄着从马背上摔了下来，重重地摔在碎石上。
寒锋剑脱手而出，落在不远处的碎石上，发出“当啷”一声脆响，寒鞘依旧悬在他的背后，在残阳下，透着一丝冰冷的寒意。北狄骑兵见状，纷纷围了上来，马刀高高举起，对准了萧琰，眼中满是得意与杀意，仿佛已经看到了萧琰惨死的模样。
北狄将领缓缓走上前来，居高临下地看着躺在地上的萧琰，脸上露出一丝嘲讽的笑容：“萧琰，你终究还是倒下了。现在，交出密函，本将可以给你一个痛快，不至于让你受尽折磨。”
萧琰趴在地上，嘴角溢出一丝鲜血，他艰难地抬起头，看向北狄将领，琥珀色的瞳孔中，没有丝毫求饶，唯有一片孤勇与倔强，那眼神，仿佛在说，纵使粉身碎骨，也绝不会屈服。他想起了当年平定北疆时的热血，想起了师父的教诲，想起了边境将士们的期盼，想起了家国百姓的安宁，一股强大的力量，从他的心底涌出，支撑着他，缓缓站起身来。
他的身形摇摇欲坠，身上的伤口都在流血，每走一步，都异常艰难，脚下的碎石被鲜血浸湿，留下一个个鲜红的脚印。他缓缓伸出手，捡起不远处的寒锋剑，握紧剑柄，指尖传来长剑的冰冷触感，那股熟悉的力量，再次涌上心头。他的后背，伤口剧痛难忍，左肩的伤口也在不断失血，可他丝毫没有理会，他缓缓抬起右手，将寒锋剑，重新插入寒鞘之中。
“铮——”一声清鸣，长剑入鞘，声音清脆而凛冽，如龙吟般响彻长空，盖过了马蹄声，盖过了惨叫声，盖过了呼啸的山风，回荡在整个黑风谷之中，那声音，带着一股不屈的意志，带着一股孤勇的豪情，让在场的所有北狄骑兵，都不由得心生惧意，纷纷后退了一步。

这一剑入鞘，不是屈服，不是放弃，而是蓄力，是蛰伏，是即将爆发的前奏，一如他当年在绝境中隐忍待发，只为等待一个破局的机会。萧琰闭上双眼，深深吸了一口气，感受着周身的风声，感受着伤口的剧痛，感受着寒鞘中长剑的悸动，他在调整自己的气息，在凝聚自己最后的力量，他知道，接下来的一击，将是决定生死的一击，要么，孤勇破重围，要么，以身殉使命。
北狄将领见状，眼中闪过一丝诧异，随即又被怒火取代：“冥顽不灵！既然你执意不肯屈服，那本将就只能让你受尽折磨，再取你的狗命！”说罢，他猛地抬手，挥下马鞭，“杀！给我往死里打！”
随着一声令下，几名北狄骑兵再次挥舞着马刀，猛地向萧琰砍来。就在马刀即将砍中萧琰的瞬间，萧琰猛地睁开双眼，琥珀色的瞳孔中，闪过一丝凌厉的寒光，那眼神，如寒星般璀璨，如刀锋般锐利，一股强大的气场，瞬间从他的周身爆发而出，席卷了整个谷口。
他右手腕猛地一翻，寒锋剑再次应声出鞘，“铮”的一声清鸣，比上一次，更加凛冽，更加响亮，如惊雷般，响彻长空，寒鞘在空中微微晃动，带着一股不屈的意志，与长剑的清鸣，交织在一起，谱写着一曲孤勇的赞歌。这一次，他没有躲闪，没有迂回，而是迎着北狄骑兵的刀锋，猛地冲了上去，身形快如闪电，如一道黑色的闪电，穿梭在敌人之间。
寒锋剑在他的手中，仿佛有了生命一般，每一次挥舞，都带着凌厉的剑气，每一次刺出，都精准无误，直取要害。他的动作，不再像之前那般刻意追求灵活，而是多了几分决绝与孤勇，每一剑，都拼尽全力，每一击，都视死如归。后背的伤口被拉扯得剧痛难忍，左肩的伤口失血越来越多，体力也在快速消耗，可他丝毫没有停下脚步，依旧在奋勇拼杀，眼中的孤勇，越来越炽烈。
他一剑刺穿一名骑兵的咽喉，又一剑斩断另一名骑兵的手臂，寒锋剑上，沾满了鲜血，在残阳下，闪烁着刺眼的红光，仿佛被鲜血浸染的星辰，耀眼而夺目。北狄骑兵们，看着眼前这个浑身是血，却依旧奋勇拼杀的身影，心中的惧意，越来越浓，他们开始退缩，开始畏惧，再也没有了之前的嚣张与狂妄，仿佛面对的，不是一个重伤的人，而是一尊不可战胜的神。
萧琰的呼吸，越来越急促，胸口剧烈起伏，身上的伤口，已经麻木，不再有剧烈的疼痛感，他的视线，开始有些模糊，可他依旧握紧寒锋剑，依旧在奋勇拼杀，他的心中，只有一个信念，那就是，破重围，护密函，守家国，不负初心，不负使命。他就像一株生长在绝境中的寒松，历经风雨，历经磨难，却依旧坚韧不拔，依旧孤勇不屈。
他猛地身形一跃，避开迎面射来的箭矢，随即，他右手腕一扬，寒锋剑直刺而出，凌厉的剑气，瞬间刺穿了两名北狄骑兵的胸膛。就在这时，北狄将领见状，怒不可遏，亲自挥舞着马刀，猛地向萧琰砍来，刀锋带着凌厉的风声，直逼萧琰的胸口，那力道，足以将萧琰劈成两半。
萧琰见状，没有丝毫躲闪，他咬紧牙关，强撑着身体，握紧寒锋剑，迎着北狄将领的刀锋，猛地刺了过去。他的动作，看似缓慢，却精准无误，剑尖直刺北狄将领的心脏，那孤勇的眼神，让北狄将领不由得心生惧意，想要躲闪，却已经来不及了。
“噗嗤”一声，寒锋剑精准地刺穿了北狄将领的心脏，北狄将领脸上的得意与杀意，瞬间凝固，取而代之的，是难以置信与恐惧。他缓缓低下头，看向胸口的长剑，又看向萧琰，嘴唇动了动，想要说什么，却终究没能发出一丝声音，身体一软，从马背上摔了下来，重重地摔在碎石上，没了气息。
北狄骑兵见状，纷纷吓得魂飞魄散，群龙无首，再也没有了之前的斗志，一个个面面相觑，眼中满是恐惧与慌乱，再也不敢上前，纷纷向后退缩。他们怎么也没想到，重伤在身、孤军深入的萧琰，竟然真的能斩杀他们的将领，竟然有如此强悍的战斗力，这般孤勇，这般坚韧，让他们心生敬畏，也心生恐惧。
萧琰握紧寒锋剑，缓缓抬起头，看向眼前的北狄骑兵，浑身是血，身形摇摇欲坠，可他的眼神，依旧坚定如初，依旧冷冽如冰，那孤勇的气场，依旧笼罩着整个谷口。他没有再发起攻击，只是静静地站在那里，后背的寒鞘，在残阳下，透着一丝冰冷的寒意，手中的寒锋剑，沾满了鲜血，在残阳下，闪烁着刺眼的红光，长剑微微震颤，发出细微的清鸣，仿佛在庆祝胜利，又仿佛在诉说着孤勇的过往。
“滚。”萧琰的声音，沙哑而微弱，却带着一股不容置喙的威严，穿透呼啸的山风，回荡在山谷之中。那声音，带着一股孤勇的豪情，带着一股不屈的意志，让在场的所有北狄骑兵，都不由得浑身一震，纷纷转身，狼狈不堪地逃离了黑风谷，马蹄声越来越远，最终，消失在山谷的尽头，只留下漫天尘土，在残阳下，缓缓消散。
危机解除，重围得破。萧琰再也支撑不住，身体一软，踉跄着后退了一步，重重地靠在岩壁上，长长地舒了一口气，嘴角，终于露出一丝微弱的笑容，那笑容，带着疲惫，带着伤痛，却更多的，是孤勇破围后的释然与坚定。
他缓缓抬起右手，将寒锋剑，重新插入寒鞘之中，“铮”的一声清鸣，再次响彻长空，那声音，清脆而凛冽，带着一股不屈的意志，带着一股孤勇的豪情，回荡在整个黑风谷之中，久久不散。寒鞘归位，长剑蛰伏，可那股孤勇的气息，却依旧萦绕在萧琰的周身，未曾消散。
残阳依旧，血色满天。萧琰靠在岩壁上，闭上双眼，呼吸渐渐平稳下来，身上的伤口，依旧在流血，可他的心中，却一片坚定。他知道，这一次，他凭借着自己的孤勇，冲破了重围，守住了密函，守住了自己的使命。可他也知道，前路依旧艰难，还有更多的危机，在等待着他，还有更多的使命，需要他去完成。
但他无所畏惧。孤勇藏心，寒鞘鸣空，纵使前路荆棘丛生，纵使未来危机四伏，他也会一如既往，坚守初心，奋勇前行，用自己的孤勇，守护家国百姓的安宁，用自己的长剑，斩断所有的奸邪与阻碍，让寒鞘的清鸣，响彻天地，让孤勇的豪情，永照山河。

The setting sun was like blood, splashing across the chaotic mountains and dangerous valleys, making Xiao Yan's figure long and lonely. His black attire had long been soaked with dust and blood, and a bone-deep wound on his left shoulder was still oozing blood. It slipped down his arm and dripped on the gravel at his feet. Dots of dark red smeared out, and the traces were swept away by the howling mountain wind in an instant. The cold scabbard sword on the back is pressed against the back. The lines on the scabbard are blurred by sweat and blood, but there is still a biting chill, like a sleeping beast, just waiting for a command to break through the shackles and roar into the sky.
Half an hour ago, he was escorting a secret letter to the border military camp. When he was passing through the Black Wind Valley, he suddenly heard the sound of horns and ambushes all around. At the head was the vanguard general of the Beidi cavalry, with a ferocious face and eyes full of greed and murderous intent. Behind him were more than 300 elite cavalry, all with their bows strung and their swords unsheathed, blocking the narrow valley mouth with water, making it difficult for even birds to cross. "Xiao Yan, hand over the secret letter and spare your body!" General Beidi's roar shook the valley, with an arrogance that could not be ignored, "You are going deep alone and there is no way out, why bother to resist pointlessly?"
Xiao Yan raised his eyes, there was no fear in his amber pupils, only a determination as cold as ice. He slowly raised his hand, wiped away the blood on his cheek, and rubbed the lines of the cold scabbard with his fingertips. It was a sword forged by his master when he was young. The sword was named "Han Feng". When you take out the scabbard, you will see blood. It has drank the blood of countless treacherous people, and has accompanied him through countless desperate situations. Twelve years ago, he accompanied his father in the Northern Xinjiang expedition and rode through the enemy camp alone. At that time, he was high-spirited and sharp. Now, although he is trapped in a tight siege and seriously injured, he still has not forgotten his mission - the secret letter is related to the lives of hundreds of thousands of soldiers on the border and the peace of the people of his home and country. Even if he is shattered into pieces, he must not fall into the hands of the enemy.
"If you want a secret letter, you must step over my body first." Xiao Yan's voice was not high, but every word was sonorous, penetrating the howling mountain wind and echoing in the valley. He leaned forward slightly and quietly held the hilt of the Hanfeng Sword with his right hand. His knuckles turned white from the exertion, and the thick calluses on his palm closely adhered to the lines on the hilt. That was the mark left by holding the sword for many years, and it was also his only confidence when facing a desperate situation. Severe pain came from the wound on his left shoulder. Every time he moved, it felt like countless steel needles were piercing him. Cold sweat slid down his forehead and soaked the broken hair on his forehead, but it did not shake his determination at all.
Seeing this, General Beidi laughed angrily: "If you don't drink a toast, you'll have to drink a fine wine! Since you insist on seeking death, I will help you and let you die without a body!" After saying that, he suddenly raised his hand and waved his riding whip, "Kill! Take off Xiao Yan's head, there will be many rewards!"
Following the order, the Beidi cavalry swarmed forward, the sound of horse hooves was deafening, the dust was thrown up, and the entire valley entrance was shrouded in gray mist. The sharp saber shone with a dazzling cold light in the setting sun, and the arrows came like raindrops, with the sound of whistling wind, hitting Xiao Yan's vital parts. Such a desperate situation is comparable to the time when Xiao Yan was besieged by the Star-Zhaing Old Ghost in the Soul Mountain Range, with such a disparity in strength and being so isolated and helpless. However, in Xiao Yan's eyes, there was no flinching, only the loneliness was burning.
Xiao Yan did not retreat but advanced instead. He jerked his body to one side and barely managed to avoid the arrow that was coming towards him. The arrow flew past his ear and hit the rock wall behind him, making a muffled "Puff" sound. At the same time, he flipped his right wrist violently, and the Hanfeng Sword was unsheathed. A clear "Zheng" sound resounded through the sky like a dragon's roar, cutting through the dust and fog in the sky. The cold sword energy rushed towards his face, causing the Beidi cavalry who were rushing at the front to pause. A trace of fear flashed in their eyes.
With the cold sheath hanging in the air and the long sword in hand, Xiao Yan's whole body seemed to be enveloped in a layer of icy aura. His movements were as fast as lightning, and his figure shuttled through the cavalry formation, as erratic as a ghost. The wound on his left shoulder was still bleeding, and the severe pain continued to erode his consciousness, but he didn't pay any attention to it., all attention is focused on the enemy in front of you. He is well versed in fighting and knows that he has no chance of winning if he fights alone. Only by relying on his flexible body skills to find the enemy's flaws and defeat them one by one can he have a chance of survival.
A Beidi cavalryman brandished his saber and slashed at Xiao Yan. The blade made a sharp sound as it hit his neck. Xiao Yan dwarfed slightly. While avoiding the blade, he raised his right wrist and stabbed out the Hanfeng Sword. The tip of the sword came out of a hole like a poisonous snake and accurately pierced the throat of the cavalryman. Blood spurted out and splashed on Xiao Yan's face. The warm touch did not move him at all. He twisted his wrist, pulled out his long sword, and brought out a string of blood beads. Another cavalry took the opportunity to attack from the side. He touched the ground with his left foot and jumped up into the air. While avoiding the attack, the long sword swept down and cut off the cavalry's arm with a "puff". The screams resounded throughout the valley.
The battle is about to break out and intensify. Xiao Yan relied on his superb swordsmanship and flexible body skills to fight bravely in the Beidi cavalry formation. Every time the Hanfeng Sword was unsheathed, it was accompanied by a clear sound, and every time it was swung, it could take away a life. His movements were crisp and neat, without any sloppiness. His sword went straight to the vital point, like a Shura from hell, which was intimidating. However, there were many Beidi cavalry, and they kept coming, killing one group and another. Xiao Yan's physical strength was rapidly depleting, and the wound on his left shoulder was losing more and more blood. His figure gradually became a little unstable, his steps began to be sloppy, and the cold sweat on his forehead kept sliding down his cheeks, dripping on the long sword, making small splashes.
General Beidi stood in the distance, looking at Xiao Yan who was fighting bravely in the formation. A trace of surprise flashed in his eyes, which was then replaced by greed. He did not expect that Xiao Yan, who was seriously injured, could still have such strong fighting power, be so lonely and brave, and be so tenacious. If he could be subdued, it would be a great help. But then I thought about it, Xiao Yan was loyal and would never surrender to Beidi. Instead of leaving any trouble in the future, it would be better to kill him as soon as possible and take down the secret letter.
"Trash! A bunch of trash! They can't even kill a seriously injured person!" General Beidi roared angrily and waved his whip again, "Give them all to me! Kill Xiao Yan at all costs!"
As the general roared, the Beidi cavalry attacked more fiercely. They changed their tactics and no longer charged blindly. Instead, they formed an encirclement, tightly surrounding Xiao Yan in the middle, trying to exhaust his energy and then kill him. Arrows are still coming like raindrops, and the sound of sabers waving is endless. Enemies are everywhere around Xiao Yan, and there are fatal crises everywhere, just like when Xiao Yan was surrounded by a dragnet formed by Fei Tian's body and avatar, so desperate and suffocating.
Xiao Yan was breathing heavily, his chest was heaving violently, and there were a few more wounds on his body. The blood soaked his clothes. He looked miserable, but his eyes were still as firm as before, without wavering at all. He knew that he could not fall. Once he fell, the secret message would fall into the hands of the enemy, the lives of hundreds of thousands of soldiers on the border would be in crisis, and the people of his home and country would suffer from war. He gritted his teeth, braced himself, held the Hanfeng Sword tightly, and attacked again.
He suddenly spun around and swept out his long sword. The sharp sword energy instantly forced back several cavalrymen around him. Then, he touched the head of a cavalryman with his toes, jumped up in the air, and looked down from a high position. The long sword stabbed straight down, accurately hitting the gap in the helmet of a cavalryman and piercing his head. The moment he drew out his sword, there was a sharp sound of wind behind him. A Beidi cavalry took the opportunity to slash at him with a sword. Xiao Yan had no time to dodge, and a long wound was opened on his back by the saber. Blood instantly poured out. The severe pain made him groan, and he staggered off the horse and fell heavily on the gravel.
The Hanfeng Sword came out of his hand and landed on the gravel not far away., making a crisp sound of "clang", the cold sheath was still hanging on his back, with a hint of icy chill under the setting sun. Seeing this, the Beidi cavalry surrounded him one after another, raising their sabers high and aiming at Xiao Yan. Their eyes were full of pride and murderous intent, as if they had seen Xiao Yan's tragic death.
General Beidi slowly walked forward and looked down at Xiao Yan who was lying on the ground, with a mocking smile on his face: "Xiao Yan, you fell down after all. Now, by handing over the secret letter, I can give you a good time and save you from torture."
Xiao Yan was lying on the ground, with a trace of blood spilling from the corner of his mouth. He raised his head with difficulty and looked at General Beidi. There was no begging for mercy in his amber pupils, only courage and stubbornness. His eyes seemed to say that even if he was shattered to pieces, he would never give in. He thought of his passion when pacifying the northern frontier, of his master's teachings, of the expectations of the soldiers on the border, and of the peace of the people of his home and country. A powerful force surged out from the bottom of his heart, supporting him and slowly stood up.
His figure was shaky, and the wounds on his body were bleeding. Every step he took was extremely difficult. The gravel under his feet was soaked with blood, leaving bright red footprints. He slowly stretched out his hand, picked up the Hanfeng Sword not far away, and held the hilt tightly. The cold touch of the sword came to his fingertips, and the familiar power surged into his heart again. The wound on his back was in unbearable pain, and the wound on his left shoulder was also losing blood, but he ignored it at all. He slowly raised his right hand and reinserted the Hanfeng Sword into the cold sheath.
"Zheng——" There was a clear cry, and the sword was sheathed. The sound was crisp and sharp, resounding through the sky like a dragon's roar, covering up the sound of horse hooves, the screams, and the howling mountain wind. It echoed throughout the Black Wind Valley. That sound, with an unyielding will and a lonely pride, made all the Beidi cavalry present feel fear and took a step back.
When the sword is sheathed, it is not surrender, not giving up, but accumulating strength, dormant, and a prelude to an upcoming explosion, just like when he endured the desperate situation, just waiting for a chance to break the situation. Xiao Yan closed his eyes and took a deep breath, feeling the sound of wind around him, the sharp pain of the wound, and the throbbing of the long sword in the cold sheath. He was adjusting his breath and condensing his last strength. He knew that the next blow would be the one that determines life and death. He would either break through the siege alone or die in his mission.
When General Beidi saw this, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes, which was soon replaced by anger: "You are stubborn! Since you are determined not to give in, I will only let you suffer all kinds of torture and then take your life!" After that, he suddenly raised his hand and waved his riding crop, "Kill! Beat me to death!"
Following the order, several Beidi cavalrymen waved their sabers again and slashed at Xiao Yan. Just when the saber was about to hit Xiao Yan, Xiao Yan opened his eyes suddenly, and a sharp cold light flashed in his amber pupils. His eyes were as bright as cold stars and as sharp as a blade. A powerful aura instantly burst out from his body and swept through the entire valley.
He flipped his right wrist violently, and the cold sword was unsheathed again. The clear "zheng" sound was sharper and louder than the last time, like thunder, resounding through the sky. The cold sheath swayed slightly in the air, with an unyielding will, intertwined with the clear sound of the long sword, composing a hymn of lonely courage. This time, he did not dodge or take a detour, but rushed forward to meet the blade of the Beidi cavalry. His body was as fast as lightning, and like a black lightning, he shuttled between the enemies.
The Hanfeng Sword seemed to be alive in his hand. Every time he swung it, there was sharp sword energy. Every time he thrust out, it was accurate and hit the vital point. His movements are no longer as deliberately flexible as before.Instead, he has a bit more determination and courage. Every sword is thrown with all his strength, and every blow is treated as though death is coming. The wound on his back was stretched and the pain was unbearable. The wound on his left shoulder was losing more and more blood, and his physical strength was rapidly depleting. However, he did not stop at all and was still fighting bravely. The loneliness in his eyes became more and more intense.
He pierced the throat of a cavalryman with one sword, and cut off the arm of another cavalryman with another sword. The cold edge sword was covered with blood. Under the setting sun, it shone with a dazzling red light, like a star soaked in blood, dazzling and eye-catching. The Beidi cavalry looked at the figure in front of them who was covered in blood but still fighting bravely. The fear in their hearts became more and more intense. They began to retreat and became afraid. They no longer had the arrogance and arrogance before, as if they were not facing a seriously injured person, but an invincible god.
Xiao Yan's breathing became more and more rapid, his chest heaved violently, the wounds on his body were numb, and there was no longer severe pain. His vision began to be a little blurry, but he still held the Hanfeng Sword tightly and fought bravely. There was only one belief in his heart, that is, to break through the siege, protect the secret letter, defend the country, and live up to his original intention and mission. He is like a cold pine growing in a desperate situation. He has gone through wind and rain and hardships, but remains perseverant and unyielding.
He jumped up suddenly to avoid the arrows coming towards him. Then, he raised his right wrist and thrust out the cold sword. The sharp sword energy instantly pierced the chests of the two Beidi cavalrymen. At this moment, General Beidi saw this and became furious. He swung his saber and slashed at Xiao Yan. The blade made a sharp sound and hit Xiao Yan's chest. The force was enough to split Xiao Yan in half.
When Xiao Yan saw this, he did not dodge at all. He gritted his teeth, held up his body, held the Hanfeng sword tightly, faced General Beidi's blade, and stabbed it fiercely. His movements seemed slow, but they were precise. The tip of the sword pierced General Beidi's heart. The lonely look in his eyes made General Beidi feel fearful. He wanted to dodge, but it was too late.
With a "Pfft" sound, the Hanfeng Sword accurately pierced General Beidi's heart. The pride and murderous intent on General Beidi's face instantly solidified, replaced by disbelief and fear. He slowly lowered his head, looked at the long sword on his chest, and then looked at Xiao Yan. His lips moved and he wanted to say something, but in the end he couldn't make a sound. His body softened and he fell off the horse. He fell heavily on the gravel and lost his breath.
When the Beidi cavalry saw this, they were all frightened out of their wits. They were leaderless and no longer had the fighting spirit they had before. They all looked at each other with fear and panic in their eyes. They no longer dared to step forward and retreated back one after another. They never expected that Xiao Yan, who was seriously injured and alone in the army, could actually kill their general. He had such a strong fighting power, such a lonely bravery, and such tenacity, which made them feel awe and fear in their hearts.
Xiao Yan clenched the Hanfeng sword, slowly raised his head, and looked at the Beidi cavalry in front of him. He was covered in blood and his figure was crumbling, but his eyes were still as firm as before, as cold as ice, and that lonely and courageous aura still enveloped the entire valley mouth. He did not launch another attack, but stood there quietly. The cold sheath on his back showed a hint of icy chill under the setting sun. The cold edge sword in his hand was stained with blood and flashed with a dazzling red light under the setting sun. The long sword trembled slightly and made a subtle sound, as if celebrating victory and telling Gu Yong's past.
"Get lost." Xiao Yan's voice was hoarse and weak, but it carried an undeniable majesty that penetrated the howling mountain wind and echoed in the valley. That voice, with a sense of heroic pride and an unyielding will, made all the Beidi cavalry present feel shaken, turned around, and fled the Black Wind Valley in embarrassment. The sound of horse hooves became farther and farther, and finallyFinally, it disappeared at the end of the valley, leaving only dust in the sky, slowly dissipating under the setting sun.
The crisis is lifted and the siege is broken. Xiao Yan could no longer hold on, her body went limp, she staggered back a step, leaned heavily on the rock wall, and breathed a long sigh of relief. Finally, a faint smile appeared on the corner of her mouth. That smile was full of exhaustion and pain, but more importantly, it was the relief and determination after breaking through the siege alone.
He slowly raised his right hand and re-inserted the Hanfeng Sword into the cold sheath. A clear "zheng" sound resounded through the sky again. The sound was crisp and sharp, carrying an unyielding will and a lonely pride. It echoed throughout the Black Wind Valley and lingered for a long time. The cold scabbard returned to its position and the long sword lay dormant, but the lonely and courageous aura still lingered around Xiao Yan and never dissipated.
The setting sun is still there, and the sky is full of blood. Xiao Yan leaned against the rock wall, closed his eyes, and his breathing gradually calmed down. The wounds on his body were still bleeding, but his heart was firm. He knew that this time, with his own courage, he broke through the siege, kept the secret letter, and kept his mission. But he also knows that the road ahead is still difficult, there are more crises waiting for him, and there are more missions that he needs to complete.
But he is fearless. Even if the road ahead is full of thorns, and even if the future is full of crises, he will always stick to his original intention and move forward bravely. He will use his lone courage to protect the peace of his country and the people, and use his long sword to cut off all evil and obstacles. Let the clear cry of the cold sheath resound throughout the world, and let the lofty sentiments of the lonely man shine on the mountains and rivers forever.
